evidence: Adds `ci/test/wrap-fd-limit.sh` and updates CI test scripts to enforce an FD budget in the macOS native CI job.
rationale: The change adds file descriptor limit wrapping to macOS CI to catch NetBSD-specific FD limit regressions in per-PR runs instead of waiting for nightly CI. This improves CI test coverage for a recurring failure mode across platforms, though it does not address core build or release integrity.
